title: Human-readable release notes
hypothesis: Replacing technical changelogs with outcome-led stories will increase feature discovery among non-technical workspace admins.
successCriteria: At least 40% of readers visit a featured workflow
No increase in support clarification requests

decisions.title: Validate the narrative format
decisions.rationale: The primary metric cleared its threshold and qualitative feedback showed higher comprehension.
decisions.author: Maya Chen

decisions.title: Extend the sample
decisions.rationale: Early engagement was positive, but the first cohort was too small to call.
decisions.author: Eli Park

title: Contextual onboarding checklist
hypothesis: Adapting onboarding tasks to a team's stated goal will shorten time-to-first-value for new workspaces.

decisions.title: Begin with two goal cohorts
decisions.rationale: Limiting variants keeps the test interpretable while covering the largest signup segments.
decisions.author: Noah Williams

title: Ambient activity digest
hypothesis: A low-frequency digest of meaningful workspace changes will reconnect occasional collaborators without creating notification fatigue.
successCriteria: At least 25% of returners contribute within a session

decisions.title: Request privacy review before build
decisions.rationale: Digest selection depends on summarizing teammate activity and needs clear boundaries.
decisions.author: Ava Rodriguez

title: Command palette navigation
hypothesis: A keyboard-first command palette will make frequent navigation measurably faster for multi-project users.

decisions.title: Promote into the product roadmap
decisions.rationale: All success criteria were met with strong repeat use after four weeks.
decisions.author: Eli Park

title: Daily stand-up prompts
hypothesis: Daily async prompts will improve visibility for distributed teams with minimal meeting overhead.
successCriteria: Half of invited members respond three times weekly

decisions.title: Archive the experiment
decisions.rationale: Participation decayed after week two and teams reported that the prompt duplicated existing rituals.
decisions.author: Maya Chen
